title: 河岸生態護岸
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 由趾部沖刷、木構浮力到根系補強與季節存活，逐一拆開生態護岸的承載機制。課程要求先辨認河道變遷與植物適生條件，再安排材料、施工窗口與後續監測，以對照組觀察功能是否形成，而不把綠色外觀當成安全證明。
summaryEn: Separate the load paths of toe protection, buoyant wood, root reinforcement and seasonal plant establishment. Identify channel adjustment and vegetation suitability before selecting materials, construction windows and monitoring. Use comparison sites to examine whether the intended functions actually develop instead of treating a green bank as evidence of structural performance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「河岸剪力的尺度」與「植生莖叢的阻力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scales of bank shear" and "Drag on vegetation stems": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 河岸剪力的尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scales of bank shear: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「河岸剪力的尺度」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scales of bank shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。斷面平均水力半徑乘以能坡只能估算河段平均床面剪力，彎道外岸、橋墩附近與淹沒植物間可能有完全不同的局部荷載。選工法前應把深槽、主流線和沖刷痕跡畫在同一張圖，辨認保護對象是表土、岸趾或整個滑動體，才決定平均量是否足以篩選材料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「河岸剪力的尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads. Hydraulic radius and energy slope give a reach averaged boundary stress, while bends, obstructions and submerged plants can produce very different local loads. Map the thalweg, main current and erosion traces together. Identify whether protection targets surface soil, the toe or an entire sliding mass before deciding whether an average stress can screen a treatment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scales of bank shear” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「河岸剪力的尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scales of bank shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 河岸剪力的尺度
knowledge.text: 河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。斷面平均水力半徑乘以能坡只能估算河段平均床面剪力，彎道外岸、橋墩附近與淹沒植物間可能有完全不同的局部荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads. Hydraulic radius and energy slope give a reach averaged boundary stress, while bends, obstructions and submerged plants can produce very different local loads.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「河岸剪力的尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scales of bank shear" is correct?
options: 河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力
河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。
種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積
optionsEn: Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads.
Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems
quiz.explanation: 河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 河岸剪力的尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scales of bank shear: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「河岸剪力的尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scales of bank shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。適用邊界：假設定常近均勻流，結果是平均邊界剪力，不是外彎岸坡最大剪力或植物耐受值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa. Applicable boundary: Assumes steady approximately uniform flow; the result is average boundary stress, not maximum outer-bank stress or plant resistance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。適用邊界：假設定常近均勻流，結果是平均邊界剪力，不是外彎岸坡最大剪力或植物耐受值。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa. Applicable boundary: Assumes steady approximately uniform flow; the result is average boundary stress, not maximum outer-bank stress or plant resistance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「河岸剪力的尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scales of bank shear", which statement holds?
options: 木構的淨浮力除以錨點數就是每支錨具唯一荷載
原始植株存活百分比就是護岸抗剪強度保留百分比
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。
optionsEn: Net buoyancy divided by anchor count is the only load on each anchor
The surviving percentage of original plants equals the retained percentage of bank shear strength
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 河岸剪力的尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scales of bank shear: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「河岸剪力的尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scales of bank shear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。分別記錄裸岸、草叢與岸趾附近的沖刷，若局部集中而平均剪力不高，應增加局部水理分析，不能只提高一個平均係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements. Record erosion near bare soil, vegetation and the toe separately. Concentrated erosion despite modest average stress requires local hydraulic investigation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改以能坡增加一半重算平均剪力，再繪製兩個具有相同平均值但主流位置不同的斷面，說明哪一種情況需要增加岸趾量測，並列出判讀依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase energy slope by half and recompute average shear. Sketch two sections with equal averages but different current positions, then explain which requires additional toe measurements and what observations would justify that decision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。分別記錄裸岸、草叢與岸趾附近的沖刷，若局部集中而平均剪力不高，應增加局部水理分析，不能只提高一個平均係數。
knowledge.textEn: Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements. Record erosion near bare soil, vegetation and the toe separately. Concentrated erosion despite modest average stress requires local hydraulic investigation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 改以能坡增加一半重算平均剪力，再繪製兩個具有相同平均值但主流位置不同的斷面，說明哪一種情況需要增加岸趾量測，並列出判讀依據。
knowledge.textEn: Increase energy slope by half and recompute average shear. Sketch two sections with equal averages but different current positions, then explain which requires additional toe measurements and what observations would justify that decision.

quiz.question: 要驗證「河岸剪力的尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scales of bank shear"?
options: 在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散
optionsEn: Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated
quiz.explanation: 在同一水位下量測斷面與水面坡度，並以多點流速確認主流位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey cross sections and water surface slope at the same stage, and locate the current with multiple velocity measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 河岸剪力的尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scales of bank shear: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「河岸剪力的尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scales of bank shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。診斷須追查水下岸趾與局部流向，而非先把植株死亡判成養護不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. Investigate the submerged toe and current direction before attributing plant loss to poor maintenance alone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選工法前應把深槽、主流線和沖刷痕跡畫在同一張圖，辨認保護對象是表土、岸趾或整個滑動體，才決定平均量是否足以篩選材料。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify whether protection targets surface soil, the toe or an entire sliding mass before deciding whether an average stress can screen a treatment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。診斷須追查水下岸趾與局部流向，而非先把植株死亡判成養護不足。
knowledge.textEn: A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. Investigate the submerged toe and current direction before attributing plant loss to poor maintenance alone.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「河岸剪力的尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scales of bank shear" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。
種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact.
Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems
quiz.explanation: 彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 植生莖叢的阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drag on vegetation stems: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「植生莖叢的阻力」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drag on vegetation stems” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。迎流面積不是種植面積，而是投影在垂直流向平面的有效面積；柔軟植株彎伏後，面積與阻力係數會隨流速改變。群生植物還會彼此遮蔽或集中水流，因此單株試驗不能簡單乘株數。設計時應區分柔性變形、折斷和連根拔起三條失效路徑，並保留季節葉量不同的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「植生莖叢的阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots. Frontal area is projected perpendicular to the current, not planted ground area. Flexible plants reconfigure, changing both area and drag coefficient as velocity increases. Neighbouring stems can shelter one another or concentrate flow, so multiplying an isolated plant test by stem count is unreliable. Distinguish bending, stem breakage and root pullout, and retain seasonal changes in foliage as separate loading conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drag on vegetation stems” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「植生莖叢的阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drag on vegetation stems”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 植生莖叢的阻力
knowledge.text: 植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。迎流面積不是種植面積，而是投影在垂直流向平面的有效面積；柔軟植株彎伏後，面積與阻力係數會隨流速改變。
knowledge.textEn: Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots. Frontal area is projected perpendicular to the current, not planted ground area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「植生莖叢的阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drag on vegetation stems" is correct?
options: 種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積
表層根系密度可直接代表任何深度滑動面的補強能力
植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。
optionsEn: Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems
Surface root density directly represents reinforcement on a failure plane at any depth
Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots.
quiz.explanation: 植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 植生莖叢的阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drag on vegetation stems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「植生莖叢的阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drag on vegetation stems” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。適用邊界：固定投影面積與阻力係數的準定常示例，未模擬彎伏、波動或群生效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N. Applicable boundary: A quasi-steady example with fixed projected area and drag coefficient, excluding reconfiguration, fluctuations and group effects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。適用邊界：固定投影面積與阻力係數的準定常示例，未模擬彎伏、波動或群生效應。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N. Applicable boundary: A quasi-steady example with fixed projected area and drag coefficient, excluding reconfiguration, fluctuations and group effects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「植生莖叢的阻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drag on vegetation stems", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。
剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定
採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3.
Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 植生莖叢的阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drag on vegetation stems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「植生莖叢的阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drag on vegetation stems” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。把力除以速度平方後查看是否仍接近常數，若偏離便追查形狀改變，勿先當成儀器漂移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually. Photograph the projected area. Examine force divided by velocity squared; changes may indicate reconfiguration rather than unexplained electronic sensor drift. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將流速增加百分之二十五並保持面積不變重算，再提出一個彎伏後面積縮小的對照案例，說明為何兩者的阻力增幅不同，以及所需影像資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase velocity by twenty five percent at fixed area, then construct a comparison with reduced area after bending. Explain the different force changes and identify the imagery needed to distinguish these cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。把力除以速度平方後查看是否仍接近常數，若偏離便追查形狀改變，勿先當成儀器漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually. Photograph the projected area. Examine force divided by velocity squared; changes may indicate reconfiguration rather than unexplained electronic sensor drift.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將流速增加百分之二十五並保持面積不變重算，再提出一個彎伏後面積縮小的對照案例，說明為何兩者的阻力增幅不同，以及所需影像資料。
knowledge.textEn: Increase velocity by twenty five percent at fixed area, then construct a comparison with reduced area after bending. Explain the different force changes and identify the imagery needed to distinguish these cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「植生莖叢的阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drag on vegetation stems"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。
下游濃度下降就足以證明護岸永久移除了同等比例泥砂
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually.
Lower downstream concentration alone proves permanent removal of the same sediment fraction
quiz.explanation: 以可量測拉力的小型枝條模型比較直立與彎伏狀態，逐級提高流速並拍攝迎流面積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure force on a small branch model in upright and bent states while increasing velocity gradually. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 植生莖叢的阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drag on vegetation stems: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「植生莖叢的阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drag on vegetation stems” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。若只清點折枝而未查根盤位移，會漏掉尚未倒伏的損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading. Counting broken branches without checking root plate movement can miss damage in plants that remain standing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時應區分柔性變形、折斷和連根拔起三條失效路徑，並保留季節葉量不同的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish bending, stem breakage and root pullout, and retain seasonal changes in foliage as separate loading conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。若只清點折枝而未查根盤位移，會漏掉尚未倒伏的損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading. Counting broken branches without checking root plate movement can miss damage in plants that remain standing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「植生莖叢的阻力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drag on vegetation stems" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
表層根系密度可直接代表任何深度滑動面的補強能力
洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Surface root density directly represents reinforcement on a failure plane at any depth
Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading.
quiz.explanation: 洪水夾帶雜物會擴大有效迎流面積，使原先按清潔枝條估算的根部荷載偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris can enlarge frontal area and make clean-stem calculations underestimate root loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
